subject: Post-call recap: Sentinel evaluation — risk assumptions, owners & buy path
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomes <alex.gomes@pritech.com>; eval@pritech.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>; Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Sentinel evaluation — risk assumptions, owners & buy path

Thanks again for your time today — good discussion. I wanted to capture the pain, goals, and a proposed alignment schedule (high level) so we have a single source of truth. Please flag anything I missed or dates that look off.

Key pain / triggers
- Model latency spikes during peak search traffic causing user drop-off (~12% conversion loss)
- High per-token cost on current self-hosted stack; no graceful fallback for capacity issues
- Hard to iterate safely without good cost/latency observability across variants

Primary goals for the 90-day eval
1) Validate consistent 95th pct latency under production-like load (target <120ms)
2) Demonstrate >=35% reduction in per-token inference cost with batching + KV cache
3) Verify safe fallback to smaller variant with <3% UX delta under outage scenarios

Proposed alignment schedule (draft) — owners and decision lane
- Week 1 (by 2026-09-10): Finalize evaluation scope & access (Owner: Alex Gomes)
- Week 2–3 (by 2026-09-21): Test environment access + baseline metric collection (Owner: PriTech engineering)
- Week 4 (by 2026-10-01): Pilot run 1 (latency & cost measurement) — Redwood devs + PriTech SREs
- Week 6 (by 2026-10-15): Pilot run 2 + regression checks on quality (Owner: Alex / Maria)
- Week 8 (by 2026-10-29): Exec review & commercial decision (PriTech procurement + Redwood sales)

Risk assumptions we called out on the call
- Data access: we assume read-only model inputs can be routed via a staging VPC we’ll agree on
- Traffic shape: you’ll provide a 48-hour synthetic replay representing peak + baseline
- Security: SOC2 evidence to be provided — timeline ~5 business days for initial artifacts

Immediate asks (action items)
- Alex: confirm the access window (Dev VPN credentials / CIDR) and point person for SREs
- PriTech Eval Team: share the 48-hour traffic replay sample by 2026-09-06
- Redwood (me): I’ll attach a draft alignment schedule and risk appendix for your review (attached)

Attachments: Sentinel_MPA_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet), Sentinel-risk-appendix.pdf (summary)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short one-click calendar for a 30-minute alignment next week.

—
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Sentinel evaluation — risk assumptions, owners & buy path

Appreciate the clear write-up, Marcus — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Stakeholders: please add Maria Torres (CFO) to the decision lane — she needs the cost delta summary before exec review.
2) Dates: the 48-hour traffic replay will be available on 2026-09-08 (we have one more compliance check).
3) Access: our SRE lead is Pedro Alvarez (pedro.alvarez@pritech.com) — he’ll coordinate VPN and CIDR.

We reviewed the risk appendix and had one comment: the replay will include encrypted payloads for PII; we need to confirm Redwood’s handling and redaction approach. Can Laura or Soojin share the SOC2 evidence and redaction workflow?

Also — we’d like to add a quick commercial milestone: an LOI or pilot commitment by 2026-10-20 if the pilot metrics look good. Not binding, but helpful for our procurement planning.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform, PriTech
